title: Near-Optimal Complexity of Finite-Sum Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization
summary: We characterize, up to logarithmic factors, the minimax expected query complexity of finite-sum nonconvex-strongly-concave optimization under mean-squared averaged smoothness. For randomized zero-respecting incremental first-order algorithms, the complexity is $\tildeΘ(n+\min\{\sqrt{n}\,κ,n^{3/4}\sqrtκ\}\,LΔ\varepsilon^{-2})$ throughout $κ=L/μ\ge1$, under exact dual initialization and for $0 0$ is universal.
